svg.title: One-class support vector anomaly model
svg.desc: A one-class support vector machine draws a boundary around the normal training rows. The boundary is a weighted sum of Gaussian kernel, gamma 0.25 similarities to these support vectors, the rows on its edge; a new row far from all of them falls outside and scores as anomalous. Each is drawn on the standardised scale; hover for its alpha weight. The axes are the two principal components of the stored rows: the first is led by amount +0.69, velocity +0.67, merchant_risk -0.2; the second is led by merchant_risk +0.73, account_age -0.62, velocity +0.29.
